fact: The CNEF survey of November 2025 (ISEPCE) found low-income households in Congo facing 4.1 power cuts a day on average, and electricity agencies reporting 6.6 major shortage episodes a year; a household and agency survey, not a utility SAIFI or Enterprise Survey figure.
title: Rapport d'etude ISEPCE (penuries d'electricite et de carburant)
publisher: Comite National Economique et Financier, Secretariat General
